notes: Node.js app: the SDK is initialised at the top of the entry file (found from the start script, package.json main/bin, or a conventional name). The token is read from process.env.BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN and written to .env (git-ignored). Node does not load .env by itself: start the app with node --env-file=.env or set BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN in the environment (production, CI, containers).
